release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.47 finishes the Generator/sidebar UI polish. Generator now participates in the same draggable navigation system as the other primary tabs and preserves its dragged position across reloads. Generator also flexes to fill the available workspace instead of leaving a large black void at the bottom. In desktop Sidebar appearance, the redundant full-width top header is removed because Tachyon branding already lives in the left rail. Colored retailer marks are restored in the Tasks hierarchy for Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, and Amazon and in the Generator hierarchy for Walmart, Target, and Amazon. Chromium regression coverage verifies real HTML5 drag persistence, rendered colored retailer artwork, computed sidebar header visibility, Generator pane/shell geometry and bottom gap, routing, and the Tachyon-native Generator group modal.
